messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023 (including the observed dates where the statutory holiday fell on a weekend). These are the dates you’ll see in most holiday‑planning apps for Canada:

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** (observed) | Jan 1 (​Sun) → observed Mon Jan 2 | **Dec 30 – Jan 3** |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Mon) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | **May 20 – May 22** |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | Jul 1 (Sat) → observed Mon Jul 3 | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed) | Nov 11 (Sat) → observed Mon Nov 13 | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that create their own long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17–19, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island on Apr 23–25).  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) was a Tuesday in 2023, so it didn’t form a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates straight into your app’s calendar or use them as a template for future years!
